statement: theorem regret_fixed (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hloss : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (hlegal : LegalFeedback V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p u T ≤ ‖x₁ - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + η / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖selected V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2) - ‖output V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)
source_assumptions: (hlegal : LegalFeedback V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T)
